swing_estimate.method: mean fractional-grid-step timing offset of onsets nearest EVEN positions (on-8th) vs ODD positions (the following off-16th); positive = off-16th lands later (swung)

downbeat_check.assumption: loop starts on beat 1 (downbeat at t=0s)

assumptions: band-split (<120 Hz / 120 Hz-2 kHz / >2 kHz) is a KICK / SNARE-CLAP / HAT PROXY, not source separation — a hat transient still has low-frequency click energy and a kick has harmonics past 2 kHz; treat 'low band' as 'where a kick dominates in a mix', not 'the isolated kick track'.
4/4 time signature assumed for the grid-step math (step duration = (60/bpm) * (4/grid)).

loop is assumed to start on beat 1 (downbeat at t=0s) — checked against the low band's first onset on 3780/3780 loop(s) with a detectable low-band onset; 3780 landed within 161 ms of t=0 (the assumption held for every checked loop).
n=3780 loop(s) — a PILOT sample size; treat position probabilities as suggestive, not definitive, until the full dataset is mined.
